disclaimer.title: Important Notice and Limitation of Liability
disclaimer.p1: This application is a purely informational and self-tracking tool based on the current scientific literature (including Monash University guidelines and studies indexed on PubMed).
disclaimer.p2: The software does NOT provide medical diagnoses, does NOT prescribe treatments and in no way replaces the advice of a physician, gastroenterologist or professional dietitian.
disclaimer.p3: Gastrointestinal disorders, including symptoms attributable to Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), can overlap with more severe organic conditions (such as celiac disease or inflammatory bowel diseases - IBD).
disclaimer.p4: It is essential to undergo clinical evaluation and rule out other conditions under specialist supervision before starting a restrictive low-FODMAP diet. A prolonged, unsupervised elimination diet can negatively alter the gut microbiota.
disclaimer.p5: The educational articles are popular-science summaries: they cite their sources but may not reflect the latest evidence, so always check the original studies. Do not change therapies or diets prescribed for diagnosed conditions (such as celiac disease, IBD or cancer) without consulting your doctor.
disclaimer.accept: I have read, understood and accept

app_subtitle: Science-based tool focused on the FODMAP protocol and structural cellular needs.
report_placeholder: Enter your biometric data and press "Calculate" to view your personalized structural requirements.
report_energy_note: Estimated total energy: {{kcal}} kcal/day (Mifflin-St Jeor + activity level).
ibs_rec_d: With IBS-D favor soluble fiber (psyllium, oats) and limit polyols and large fat loads in a single meal: they reduce the osmotic effect and modulate the gastrocolic reflex.
ibs_rec_c: With IBS-C increase fiber gradually (soluble/insoluble mix) while meeting the hydration target: fiber without water further slows transit.
ibs_rec_m: With IBS-M alternate attention to fermentables and soluble fiber: use the diary to learn which transit direction responds best to changes.
ibs_rec_unknown: Without a defined subtype, proceed stepwise: a short low-FODMAP phase 1, then single reintroductions tracked in the diary.
filter_no_results: No foods match your search criteria or exclusion filters.
diet_link_cta: Fill in the calculator to link your structural requirements to the diet phases.
diet_need_results: Fill in the calculator to generate meals portioned on your targets (grams, kcal, macros and micronutrients).
diet_reintroduced: Reintroduction food (phase 3): include only if tolerated

conditions.celiac_note: Targets shown are generic: follow your specialist's plan; a strict gluten-free diet is mandatory.
conditions.celiac_diet: Exclude all gluten sources (wheat, barley, rye, contaminated oats); prefer rice, quinoa and certified gluten-free options.
conditions.diabetes_note: Fiber target raised to ≥30 g/day to support glycemic control; distribute carbs evenly across meals.
conditions.diabetes_diet: Prefer low-glycemic-index carbs (oats, quinoa, legumes if tolerated); avoid large carb loads in a single meal.
conditions.hypertension_note: Moderate added salt; favor herbs and spices over sodium-rich seasonings.
conditions.hypertension_diet: Limit added salt and aged cheeses; flavor with chives and garlic-infused oil (low-FODMAP).
conditions.lactose_intolerance_note: Lactose-free dairy or aged cheeses are already in line with the low-FODMAP approach.
conditions.lactose_intolerance_diet: Use lactose-free milk and aged cheeses (Parmigiano); avoid fresh soft cheeses with residual lactose. Generated meals automatically exclude milk and fresh cheeses.

diary_transit_hint: 1 = very slow transit · 4 = optimal · 7 = very accelerated
water_reminder_denied: Notifications blocked: enable them in the browser settings.
water_reminder_unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
water_reminder_hint: You will get a notification every 75 minutes while this page stays open.
diary_reset_meal_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to reset all data for {{meal}}?
diary_reset_day_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to reset all data for today? This action cannot be undone.
diary_needs_calc_message: To view progress bars and nutritional warnings, you first need to calculate your daily nutritional needs in the Calculator tab.

warnings.protein_deficiency: Protein deficiency: increase protein intake to support tissues and immune system.
warnings.fiber_deficiency: Fiber deficiency: increase intake of vegetables, fruits and whole grains for microbiota health.
warnings.iron_deficiency: Iron deficiency: increase intake of meat, legumes, spinach or fortified foods.
warnings.vitamin_d_deficiency: Vitamin D deficiency: consider supplementation or increase sun exposure (consult your doctor).
warnings.calcium_deficiency: Calcium deficiency: increase intake of dairy, leafy greens or fortified foods.

workout_show_exercise: Show the exercise and how to perform it
devices_note: Device connections are coming in future versions (Apple Health, Health Connect, manufacturer APIs). Meanwhile you can log measurements manually below.
devices_manual_hint: One entry per day: saving again today overwrites today's values.
device_scale_desc: Weight, body fat and lean mass synced via Bluetooth/Wi-Fi (e.g., Withings, Garmin Index).
device_watch_desc: Steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts: useful to calibrate the calculator's activity level.
device_fitness_desc: Strava, Apple Health, Google Health Connect: import workouts into your plan.
device_tape_desc: Waist, hip and body circumference tracking beyond weight.
